name: TARE
author: optim-agent
description:
Subset-sum with a bitmask answer. Clue is 'a b c ...|T': 6-9 positive ints and a target
T that is the sum of some non-empty subset (guaranteed solvable, built that way). A solution
is a 0/1 string of exactly the same length as the number list; the selected numbers must sum
to T exactly. DIFFICULTY: easy (the anchor of my batch).
DISCOVERY PATH: the name (tare = the weight you subtract on a balance) plus one demo, which
shows a mask whose length equals the count of numbers -- an AI immediately checks 'sum of the
marked numbers == the number after the bar'. Gradient: teams that send the chosen *numbers*
instead of a mask score 0 every time until the demo, then it is a 2^9 brute force.
